error.description: Present instead of a pet. `not found` is the ORIGINAL spelling, with a space, and it stays that way: PetPage branches on it and renaming it would break the public profile page for no gain.

aturi.description: Hydrate ONE pet by its at-uri, as listed by pet.trezy.getPets. This is the mode the roster uses: the list call returns identifiers and each is fetched here, which keeps a large collection off the wire. Takes precedence over `did`.

did.description: Whose newest pet to return. Ignored when `aturi` is given. One of the two is required — sending neither refuses, because defaulting to anything here would answer about somebody.
